design.split_method: patient-stratified; SHA-256 ordering of (seed, gene, patient key) within class, dealt round-robin
design.gene_eligibility: at least 5 patients in each class, decided from label counts before any model is run
design.endpoint: Label 0 means no qualifying alteration was reported for this gene. It does not establish that the gene is unaltered.
design.score_direction: fixed: higher probability = reported qualifying alteration; never flipped
design.preprocessing: imputation and scaling are fitted inside each training fold; test rows never inform them
design.held_out_labels: never passed to an arm; read only by the scorer after probabilities are returned
design.selection: no hyperparameter search, no model or gene selection on held-out results

bootstrap.note: conditional on the fitted folds; not a confidence interval for a new cohort

dataset_metadata.endpoint: Reported qualifying pathogenic/likely pathogenic alteration versus no qualifying report among mutation-record patients; not biological wild type or proven complete panel coverage.
dataset_metadata.age_status: excluded: consistent birth/scan date-shift semantics not established
